caseNameFull: Bellotti, Attorney General of Massachusetts v. Baird and Hunerwadel v. Baird

opinions.text: D. C. Mass. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 925.] Motion of Legal Defense Fund for Unborn Children for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied. Motions of Americans United for Life, Inc., et ah, Catholic League for Religious and Civil Rights et al., and United States Catholic Conference for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.
